responsibility: Implements the symbol visibility and whole-program locality passes that regularize function and variable visibility before and during IPA. It privatizes eligible public symbols, discovers local functions, dismantles or preserves COMDAT groups based on usage and resolution info, creates local aliases where interposition can be bypassed safely, updates variable visibility/TLS behavior, and handles related cleanup such as empty constructor/destructor removal. This file owns symbol-visibility policy, not callgraph construction or COMDAT localization analysis.
